name: IISc C. V. Raman Post-Doctoral Fellowship
amount: Rs 1.15 lakh/month consolidated (incl. HRA) + Rs 8 lakh/year research grant (up to Rs 2 lakh for travel)
other_rules: PhD with a first-class record (thesis-submitted candidates can join as provisional RA at Rs 45,000/month)
OCI, PIO and foreign nationals eligible
must have a consenting IISc faculty host
notes: The only IISc call page found closed 29 Feb 2024; check iisc.ac.in for the current round. One-year appointment. Needs a research plan of up to 500 words and 2-5 key publications.
